description: Page-level SEO/GEO audit of one rendered HTML page, before it ships. Checks: visible_text (characters readable with JavaScript off, excluding

checks.description: Run only these checks. Default: all six.

cite_ok.description: outbound_links: domains you cite editorially, matched with their subdomains, e.g. ["gov.uk"]. Ordinary editorial links need no rel, so this is the right fix for a reported citation, not adding nofollow. Registries anyone can register under (co.uk, github.io, pages.dev...) are refused. Never list paid or affiliate partners here: those need rel="sponsored".

html.description: Rendered HTML of the page, as the server sends it.

min_chars.description: visible_text: minimum characters readable with JavaScript off. 1200 is a house rule, not a search-engine number.

require_types.description: structured_data: @type values that must be present.

stock_phrases.description: stock_phrases: phrases to flag, matched case-insensitively. Default: one editor's Traditional Chinese list, whose connectives (因此，, 然而，) also flag ordinary sentences; replace it with your own, and always for other languages.

url.description: The page's public URL. Decides which links are external and whether this is the home page.

name: audit_page
